            double a1iv = (aImag[i] - aImag[j]) / 2;
            double a2rv = (aImag[i] + aImag[j]) / 2;
            double a2iv = (aReal[j] - aReal[i]) / 2;

            double b1rv = (bReal[i] + bReal[j]) / 2;
            double b1iv = (bImag[i] - bImag[j]) / 2;
            double b2rv = (bImag[i] + bImag[j]) / 2;
            double b2iv = (bReal[j] - bReal[i]) / 2;

            cRe[i] = a1rv * b1rv - a1iv * b1iv - a2rv * b2iv - a2iv * b2rv;
            cIm[i] = a1rv * b1iv + a1iv * b1rv + a2rv * b2rv - a2iv * b2iv;
            dRe[i] = a1rv * b2rv - a1iv * b2iv + a2rv * b1rv - a2iv * b1iv;
            dIm[i] = a1rv * b2iv + a1iv * b2rv + a2rv * b1iv + a2iv * b1rv;
        }
        performFFT(cRe, cIm, true);
        performFFT(dRe, dIm, true);
        int[] result = new int[need];
        for (int i = 0; i < need; i++) {
            long aVal = (long) (cRe[i] + 0.5);
            long bVal = (long) (dRe[i] + 0.5);
            long cVal = (long) (cIm[i] + 0.5);
            result[i] = (int) ((aVal + ((bVal % mod) << 15) + ((cVal % mod) << 30)) % mod);
        }
        return result;
    }

    static void performFFT(double[] re, double[] im, boolean inverse) {
        int n = re.length;
        int revCount = 32 - Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(n);
        int[] rev = new int[n];
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            rev[i] = (rev[i >> 1] >> 1) + ((i & 1) * n / 2);
        }
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            int j = rev[i];
            if (i < j) {
                double tempRe = re[i];
                re[i] = re[j];
                re[j] = tempRe;
                double tempIm = im[i];
                im[i] = im[j];
                im[j] = tempIm;
            }
        }
        for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
            int half = len / 2;
            double[] cosTable = new double[half];
            double[] sinTable = new double[half];
            for (int i = 0; i < half; i++) {
                double angle = 2 * Math.PI * i / len * (inverse ? -1 : 1);
                cosTable[i] = Math.cos(angle);
                sinTable[i] = Math.sin(angle);
            }
            for (int start = 0; start < n; start += len) {
                for (int i = 0; i < half; i++) {
                    double wRe = cosTable[i];
                    double wIm = sinTable[i];
                    double uRe = re[start + i];
                    double uIm = im[start + i];
                    double vRe = re[start + i + half] * wRe - im[start + i + half] * wIm;
                    double vIm = re[start + i + half] * wIm + im[start + i + half] * wRe;
                    re[start + i] = uRe + vRe;
                    im[start + i] = uIm + vIm;
                    re[start + i + half] = uRe - vRe;
                    im[start + i + half] = uIm - vIm;
                }
            }
        }
        if (inverse) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                re[i] /= n;
                im[i] /= n;
            }
        }
    }
}
